description: This Java interface, ErrorResponseAdapter, is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter package and defines a mixin for error responses within the Ditto protocol adapter. It specifies criteria and actions related to error response handling, extending a generic Adapter interface.

classes.name: ErrorResponseAdapter
classes.description: A Java interface that acts as a mixin for error response handling in the Ditto protocol adapter, parameterized on types extending ErrorResponse.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns a set containing the ERROR criterion for topic filtering.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns a set of all actions applicable to error responses.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter is intended for use with responses; always returns true.
